reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Delaware
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is the county sheriff's office an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
    Statute encoded: 25 Del. C.  5715 (2021)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% The question is asked for Delaware, focus year 2021.
scenario_state(delaware).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Entity in question.
scenario_entity(county_sheriffs_office).

% Interpret "county sheriff's office" as the sheriff (county officer) for a county.
entity_role(county_sheriffs_office, sheriff).
entity_jurisdiction(county_sheriffs_office, sample_county).

% A representative property located in that county (needed because 5715 ties the sheriff
% to "the county in which the property is located").
property(property_1).
property_location(property_1, sample_county).

% A representative eviction writ (Delaware summary possession uses a "writ of possession").
writ(writ_1, writ_of_possession, property_1).
court_issues_writ(writ_1).

% The writ is delivered to the county sheriff's office (relevant to 5715(b)).
writ_delivered_to(writ_1, county_sheriffs_office).

% Helper: the factual statement summarized as a reusable predicate.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(delaware),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_entity(E),
    entity_role(E, sheriff),
    entity_jurisdiction(E, County),
    property(P),
    property_location(P, County),
    writ(W, writ_of_possession, P),
    court_issues_writ(W),
    writ_delivered_to(W, E).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation (deterministic helpers encoding 25 Del. C. 5715)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  25 Del. C.  5715(a) (2021):
  "the court shall issue a writ of possession directed to the constable or the sheriff
   of the county in which the property is located..."
*/
statute_5715a_proper_recipient_for_writ_of_possession(Entity, Writ) :-
    writ(Writ, writ_of_possession, Property),
    property_location(Property, County),
    court_issues_writ(Writ),
    entity_jurisdiction(Entity, County),
    (   entity_role(Entity, sheriff)
    ;   entity_role(Entity, constable)
    ).

/*
  25 Del. C.  5715(b) (2021):
  "The officer to whom the writ of possession is directed and delivered shall ... execute it..."
  We model "directed and delivered" as: (a) the entity is a proper statutory recipient and
  (b) the writ is delivered to the entity.
*/
statute_5715b_officer_has_duty_to_execute(Entity, Writ) :-
    statute_5715a_proper_recipient_for_writ_of_possession(Entity, Writ),
    writ_delivered_to(Writ, Entity).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning helpers
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Mapping: treat "writ of eviction" in the question as Delaware's "writ of possession" used to remove occupants.
eviction_writ_type(writ_of_possession).

% An entity is "empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction" if Delaware law places execution
% of the relevant eviction writ on that entity when it is the proper recipient and the writ is delivered.
legal_empowered_to_execute_writ_of_eviction(Entity) :-
    eviction_writ_type(Type),
    writ(Writ, Type, _Property),
    statute_5715b_officer_has_duty_to_execute(Entity, Writ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (must be deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(Result) :-
    (   scenario_statement,
        scenario_entity(Entity),
        legal_empowered_to_execute_writ_of_eviction(Entity)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the county sheriff’s office an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
